title: New Year's Cabaret
desc: Ring in the New Year with style, soul, and unforgettable vibes at the 2025 New Year's Eve Cabaret! Join us for a night of celebration, community, music, and elegance as we count down to midnight together.

descLists.title: What to Expect
items: A powerful New Year's countdown experience
A warm, welcoming atmosphere filled with connection and celebration

descLists.title: BYOB
items: Light food, champagne toast & good vibes provided
Bring your own to keep your party going.

payment.note: More at the door — secure your spot early!

closingWords: This is more than a party — it's a New Year's experience. Dress to impress, bring your friends, and step into 2025 surrounded by great people, great energy, and unforgettable moments.
